115	        if self._est_c(case, events, t, std) <= c_open:
116	            return t
117	        lo = t["unit_price"]
118	        for i in range(1, 101):
119	            v = {**t, "unit_price": round(lo + (top - lo) * i / 100, 2)}
120	            if self._est_c(case, events, v, std) <= c_open:
121	                return v
122	        return None

124	    def _guard(self, case, threads, d):
125	        if not self.GUARD_C_OPEN:
126	            return d
127	        sid, msg = d.get("supplier_id"), d.get("message") or {}
128	        ev = threads.get(sid)
129	        if not ev:
130	            return d
131	        std, c_open = standard_terms(ev), self._open_c(case, threads)
132	        act = msg.get("action") or {}
133	        if act.get("type") == "accept":

139	        elif msg.get("term_sheets"):
140	            sheets = [s["terms"] for s in msg["term_sheets"]]
141	        else:
142	            return d
143	        first = next((m["term_sheets"][0]["terms"]["unit_price"] for m in _sup(ev) if m.get("term_sheets")), 0)

151	    # 6. late accept ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
152	    def _late_accept(self, case, threads):
153	        c_alt, c_open = _c_alt(case), self._open_c(case, threads)
154	        known, cand = math.inf, None
155	        for sid in _live(threads):
156	            ev, std = threads[sid], standard_terms(threads[sid])
157	            for s in _sheets(ev):
158	                if (t := s.get("terms") or {}).get("unit_price") is not None and must_haves_ok(case, t, std):
159	                    known = min(known, self._est_c(case, ev, t, std))
160	            sheet_id, t = standing(ev)
161	            if sheet_id and moves_left(case, ev) <= self.LATE_MESSAGES and t.get("unit_price") is not None and must_haves_ok(case, t, std):
162	                c = self._est_c(case, ev, t, std)
163	                if c < c_alt and c <= c_open:
164	                    cand = min(cand or (c, sid, sheet_id), (c, sid, sheet_id))
165	        if cand and cand[0] <= (1 + self.LATE_TOLERANCE) * known:
166	            return {"supplier_id": cand[1], "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": cand[2]}}}
167	        return None

169	    # 3. cost-share anchor -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
170	    @staticmethod
171	    def _share_factor(case):
172	        """1 - share x drop for the best index driver the case shows falling (index_paths < 0), else None."""
173	        paths = case["buyer"].get("index_paths") or {}
174	        hits = [c["material_share"] * -paths[c["series"]] for c in (case.get("term_options") or {}).get("index_clause", [])
175	                if c and paths.get(c["series"], 0) < 0]
176	        return 1 - max(hits) if hits else None
177	
178	    def _price(self, case, events, p):
179	        if self.ANCHOR_BY_SHARE and not _mine(events) and not _health_at_stake(case) and (f := self._share_factor(case)):
180	            return max(ANCHOR_FLOOR * p, min(f * p, case["buyer"].get("current_unit_price") or p))
181	        return super()._price(case, events, p)

183	    # 2 + 5. third equivalent sheet / cash-short -------------------------------------------------------------
184	    @staticmethod
185	    def _cash_short(case, events):
186	        text = " ".join([*(m.get("body") or "" for m in _sup(events)), str(case.get("suppliers", ""))])
187	        return bool(CASH_SHORT.search(text))

189	    def _trade_sheet(self, case, events, std, main, p, pins, seen):
190	        """Same C as main with another lever: shorter payment days (or another contract length) for a lower price."""
191	        short = self.CASH_SHORT_OFFER and self._cash_short(case, events)
192	        levers = ("payment_days",) if short else ("payment_days", "contract_months") if self.THIRD_SHEET else ()
193	        opts, best = case.get("term_options") or {}, None
194	        cost = lambda t: total_cost(case, t, std)  # noqa: E731
195	        for f in levers:
196	            if f not in case["negotiable"] or f in pins or (_health_at_stake(case) and f not in FREE_LEVERS):
197	                continue
198	            for o in (o for o in opts.get(f, []) if o and o != main.get(f) and (f != "payment_days" or o < main[f])):
199	                t = satisfy_must_haves(case, {**main, f: o}, std)
200	                slope = cost({**t, "unit_price": t["unit_price"] + 1}) - cost(t)
201	                if t.get(f) != o or slope <= 0:
202	                    continue
203	                price = round(min(p, t["unit_price"] - (cost(t) - cost(main)) / slope - 0.01), 2)
204	                v = {**t, "unit_price": price}
205	                if price > 0.75 * p and v not in seen and v != main and (best is None or price > best["unit_price"]):
206	                    best = v
207	            if best:
208	                break
209	        return best
210	
211	    def _sheets(self, case, events, std, theirs):
212	        out = super()._sheets(case, events, std, theirs)
213	        if out and HEALTH.get():  # never below the price that minimises C: under it the health term grows faster than the saving
214	            seen = [s["terms"] for m in _mine(events) for s in m.get("term_sheets") or []]
215	            fixed = []
216	            for t in out:
217	                grid = [round(t["unit_price"] + (theirs["unit_price"] - t["unit_price"]) * i / 100, 2) for i in range(101)]
218	                t = complete_offer(case, {**t, "unit_price": min(grid, key=lambda x: total_cost(case, {**t, "unit_price": x}, std))})
219	                if t not in fixed and t not in seen:
220	                    fixed.append(t)
221	            out = fixed
222	        if out and (self.THIRD_SHEET or self.CASH_SHORT_OFFER):
223	            seen = [s["terms"] for m in _mine(events) for s in m.get("term_sheets") or []]
224	            if extra := self._trade_sheet(case, events, std, out[0], theirs["unit_price"], _pinned(events), seen):
225	                if (extra := complete_offer(case, extra)) not in out:
226	                    out.append(extra)
227	        return out

1	"""Guard layer: wraps any delegate agent so a must-have is always ASKED for in the term sheet and an
2	open thread is never abandoned while something sensible is left to try.
3	
4	Why: practice runs lost cases with no deal because sheets were snapped (by `complete_offer`) onto
5	an option that breaks a must-have, and the agents then walked away. `satisfy_must_haves` fixes the
6	sheets; `GuardedAgent` turns a delegate's walk-away (or crash) into an accept of a safe standing
7	sheet, or into one more counter at the supplier's own price with the must-haves satisfied.
8	"""
9	
10	import logging
11	
12	from .cost import OPS, complete_offer, must_haves_ok, snap, total_cost
13	from .docs import standard_terms
14	from .play import ENDED, closing_move, latest, live_threads, moves_left, standing
15	
16	log = logging.getLogger("arena")
17	
18	MAX_COUNTERS = 2  # guard counters per thread and case
19	EARLY_ACCEPT = 0.97  # accept a safe sheet before the last move only once the supplier has moved this far
20	ASK_QUOTE = "Could you please send us your quote?"
21	ASK_BODY = "We can proceed at your price if the terms below work for you; please confirm."
22

24	def _fits(m, value):
25	    try:
26	        return value is not None and OPS[m["op"]](value, m["value"])
27	    except TypeError:
28	        return False
29	
30	
31	def _must_have_value(case, m, current):
32	    """A value for the must-have's field that satisfies it, or `current` when none can."""
33	    op, bound = m["op"], m["value"]
34	    options = [o for o in (case.get("term_options") or {}).get(m["field"]) or [] if o is not None]
35	    if options:
36	        ok = [o for o in options if _fits(m, o)]
37	        if not ok:
38	            return current
39	        if op in ("<=", "<"):
40	            return max(ok)
41	        if op in (">=", ">"):
42	            return min(ok)
43	        if op == "!=":
44	            return current if _fits(m, current) else ok[0]
45	        return bound
46	    if op in ("<=", ">=", "=="):
47	        return bound
48	    if op == "!=":
49	        return current if _fits(m, current) else (bound + 1 if isinstance(bound, int | float) else current)
50	    step = 1 if isinstance(bound, int) else 0.01
51	    return bound - step if op == "<" else bound + step

54	def satisfy_must_haves(case, terms, standard=None):
55	    """A copy of `terms` with every must-have on a negotiable field satisfied, completed to a valid
56	    sheet. Must-haves on fields we cannot negotiate are left alone."""
57	    must = [m for m in case["buyer"].get("must_haves", []) if m["field"] in case["negotiable"]]
58	    result = dict(terms)
59	    for m in must:
60	        cur = result.get(m["field"])
61	        cur = snap(case, m["field"], cur) if cur is not None else cur  # complete_offer snaps it later
62	        result[m["field"]] = cur if _fits(m, cur) else _must_have_value(case, m, cur)
63	    result = complete_offer(case, result)
64	    for m in must:  # a gap filled from the plan, or a snap, may have broken it again
65	        if not _fits(m, result.get(m["field"])):
66	            result[m["field"]] = _must_have_value(case, m, result.get(m["field"]))
67	    if not must_haves_ok(case, result, standard):
68	        log.debug("guard: must-haves still fail after fixing %s", result)
69	    return result

72	def fix_sheets(case, sheets, standard=None):
73	    """(sheets, changes): `satisfy_must_haves` on each sheet (other keys kept); exact duplicates
74	    dropped; at most 3 kept. `changes`: what was changed, per input sheet, as readable text."""
75	    out, changes = [], []
76	    for s in sheets:
77	        old = s.get("terms") or {}
78	        fixed = {**s, "terms": satisfy_must_haves(case, old, standard)}
79	        if c := ", ".join(f"{k} {old.get(k)} -> {v}" for k, v in fixed["terms"].items() if old.get(k) != v):
80	            changes.append(c)
81	        if fixed not in out:
82	            out.append(fixed)
83	    return out[:3], changes

88	    if sheets:
89	        msg["term_sheets"] = sheets
90	    return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": msg}

94	    return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}

97	class GuardedAgent:
98	    def __init__(self, delegate, log_name="arena"):
99	        self.delegate = delegate
100	        self.log = logging.getLogger(log_name)
101	        self._case_id = None
102	        self._tried = {}
103	
104	    def __getattr__(self, name):  # e.g. `.chosen` of a wrapped router
105	        if name in ("delegate", "log", "_case_id", "_tried"):
106	            raise AttributeError(name)
107	        return getattr(self.delegate, name)
108	
109	    def decide(self, case, threads):
110	        """Never raises: any failure here falls back to the guard's own continuation, then closing_move."""
111	        if not any(threads.values()):  # nothing to look at: nothing to continue
112	            return _walk(next(iter(threads), None))
113	        try:
114	            return self._decide(case, threads)
115	        except Exception:
116	            log.exception("%s guard: failed", self._case_id)
117	        try:
118	            return self._keep_going(case, threads, None, "guard failed")
119	        except Exception:
120	            log.exception("%s guard: fallback failed", self._case_id)
121	        try:
122	            return closing_move(case, threads)
123	        except Exception:
124	            return _walk(next(iter(threads), None))
125	
126	    def _decide(self, case, threads):
127	        if case.get("case_id") != self._case_id:
128	            self._case_id, self._tried = case.get("case_id"), {}
129	        error = False
130	        try:
131	            decision = self.delegate.decide(case, threads)
132	        except Exception:
133	            log.exception("%s guard: delegate crashed", self._case_id)
134	            decision, error = None, True
135	        msg = (decision or {}).get("message") or {}
136	        action = msg.get("action") or {}
137	        sid = (decision or {}).get("supplier_id")
138	        if decision and action.get("type") == "accept":
139	            if self._accept_ok(case, threads, decision):
140	                events = threads[sid]
141	                if (not any(m.get("from") == "buyer" for m in events) and moves_left(case, events) > 1
142	                        and not self._supplier_moved(case, threads, sid)):
143	                    self.log.info("%s guard: deferred round-1 accept on %s (unmoved opening offer)",
144	                                  self._case_id, sid)
145	                    return self._counter(case, threads, sid)
146	                return decision
147	            return self._keep_going(case, threads, sid, "delegate accept is not safe")
148	        if decision and msg.get("term_sheets"):
149	            sheets = self._fix(case, threads, sid, msg["term_sheets"])
150	            if sheets:
151	                return self._last_move(case, threads, {**decision, "message": {**msg, "term_sheets": sheets}})
152	        elif decision and not action:
153	            return self._last_move(case, threads, decision)  # a text-only message
154	        reason = (
155	            "delegate crashed" if error
156	            else "delegate wanted to walk" if action.get("type") == "walk_away"
157	            else f"unknown action {action.get('type')}" if action
158	            else "no usable sheet"
159	        )
160	        return self._keep_going(case, threads, sid, reason)
161	
162	    @staticmethod
163	    def _accept_ok(case, threads, decision):
164	        """The accept names the standing sheet, keeps the must-haves and beats the alternative."""
165	        sid, action = decision.get("supplier_id"), decision["message"]["action"]
166	        if sid not in threads or latest(threads[sid]).get("status") in ENDED:
167	            return False
168	        sheet_id, terms = standing(threads[sid])  # only the standing id: an `-a` id is not verified to be accepted
169	        if sheet_id is None or sheet_id != action.get("term_sheet_id"):
170	            return False
171	        std = standard_terms(threads[sid])
172	        if not must_haves_ok(case, terms, std):
173	            return False
174	        alt = (case["buyer"].get("alternative") or {}).get("terms") or {}
175	        return not alt.get("unit_price") or total_cost(case, terms, std) < total_cost(case, alt)
176	
177	    def _fix(self, case, threads, sid, sheets):
178	        std = standard_terms(threads[sid]) if sid in threads else {}
179	        fixed, changes = fix_sheets(case, sheets, std)
180	        for c in changes:
181	            self.log.info("%s guard: fixed sheet (must-have): %s", self._case_id, c)
182	        return fixed
183	
184	    def _last_move(self, case, threads, decision):
185	        """Rule e: on our last allowed message, a price push the supplier will refuse is replaced."""
186	        sid = decision["supplier_id"]
187	        if sid not in threads:
188	            return decision
189	        left = moves_left(case, threads[sid])
190	        if left > 1:
191	            return decision
192	        if left < 1:
193	            self.log.info("%s guard: closing move (no messages left on %s)", self._case_id, sid)
194	            return closing_move(case, threads)
195	        sheets = decision["message"].get("term_sheets") or []
196	        theirs = standing(threads[sid])[1].get("unit_price")
197	        prices = [p for p in (s["terms"].get("unit_price") for s in sheets) if p is not None]
198	        if theirs is None or not prices or min(prices) >= theirs:
199	            return decision
200	        close = closing_move(case, threads)
201	        if close["message"]["action"]["type"] == "accept":
202	            self.log.info("%s guard: accept on last move (a lower counter would be refused)", self._case_id)
203	            return close
204	        self.log.info("%s guard: must-have counter at their price on last move", self._case_id)
205	        return self._counter(case, threads, sid)
206	
207	    def _counter(self, case, threads, sid):
208	        events = threads[sid]
209	        _, terms = standing(events)
210	        if terms.get("unit_price") is None:
211	            body = _text(sid, ASK_QUOTE)
212	        else:
213	            sheet = satisfy_must_haves(case, dict(terms), standard_terms(events))
214	            body = _text(sid, ASK_BODY, [{"terms": sheet}])
215	        key = (self._case_id, sid)
216	        self._tried[key] = self._tried.get(key, 0) + 1
217	        return body
218	
219	    def _eligible(self, case, threads, sid):
220	        events = threads[sid]
221	        status, left = latest(events).get("status"), moves_left(case, events)
222	        cap = 1 if status == "final_offer" else MAX_COUNTERS
223	        return status not in ENDED | {"agreed"} and left >= 1 and self._tried.get((self._case_id, sid), 0) < cap
224	
225	    def _supplier_moved(self, case, threads, sid):
226	        """The standing sheet costs at most EARLY_ACCEPT x the thread's opening sheet."""
227	        events = threads[sid]
228	        std = standard_terms(events)
229	        _, terms = standing(events)
230	        opening = next((t for m in events if m.get("from") != "buyer"
231	                        for sh in m.get("term_sheets") or [] for t in [sh.get("terms") or {}]
232	                        if t.get("unit_price") is not None), None)
233	        if opening is None:
234	            return True
235	        return total_cost(case, terms, std) <= EARLY_ACCEPT * total_cost(case, opening, std)
236	
237	    @staticmethod
238	    def _hopeless(case, threads):
239	        """Every live thread is at its final offer (or out of messages) and even its must-have-fixed sheet costs
240	        no less than the alternative: a counter could only end above the alternative's C."""
241	        alt = (case["buyer"].get("alternative") or {}).get("terms") or {}
242	        if not alt.get("unit_price"):
243	            return False
244	        c_alt = total_cost(case, alt)
245	        for sid in live_threads(threads):
246	            ev = threads[sid]
247	            if latest(ev).get("status") != "final_offer" and moves_left(case, ev) >= 1:
248	                return False
249	            terms = standing(ev)[1]
250	            if terms.get("unit_price") is not None:
251	                std = standard_terms(ev)
252	                if total_cost(case, satisfy_must_haves(case, dict(terms), std), std) < c_alt:
253	                    return False
254	        return True
255	
256	    def _keep_going(self, case, threads, preferred, reason):
257	        """Rule d: never walk while something sensible is left."""
258	        close = closing_move(case, threads)
259	        if close["message"]["action"]["type"] == "walk_away" and reason == "delegate wanted to walk" and self._hopeless(case, threads):
260	            self.log.info("%s guard: walk away stands (every thread is final, no counter beats the alternative)", self._case_id)
261	            return close
262	        if close["message"]["action"]["type"] == "accept":
263	            asid = close["supplier_id"]
264	            if (moves_left(case, threads[asid]) <= 1 or not self._eligible(case, threads, asid)
265	                    or self._supplier_moved(case, threads, asid)):
266	                self.log.info("%s guard: accept a safe standing sheet (%s)", self._case_id, reason)
267	                return close
268	        live = [s for s in live_threads(threads) if self._eligible(case, threads, s)]
269	
270	        def cost(s):
271	            terms = standing(threads[s])[1]
272	            try:
273	                return total_cost(case, terms, standard_terms(threads[s])) if terms.get("unit_price") else float("inf")
274	            except Exception:
275	                return float("inf")
276	
277	        order = ([preferred] if preferred in live else []) + sorted((s for s in live if s != preferred), key=cost)
278	        if not order:
279	            self.log.info("%s guard: closing move, no thread left to continue (%s)", self._case_id, reason)
280	            return close
281	        sid = order[0]
282	        self.log.info("%s guard: counter at their price on %s (%s)", self._case_id, sid, reason)
283	        return self._counter(case, threads, sid)

import glob
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from arena_kit import evaluate
from arena_kit.agents.better_agent import BetterAgent, _health, _with_health
from arena_kit.agents.reciprocal import case_c_open
from arena_kit.cost import total_cost
from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms
from arena_kit.evidence import load_package
from arena_kit.play import find_sheet

CASES = Path(evaluate.__file__).parent / "sim_cases"


needs_data = pytest.mark.skipif(load_package() is None, reason="no data package (set ARENA_DATA)")


def _case(**options):
    b = {"need_per_year": 1000, "horizon_years": 2, "fallback_unit_price": 40.0, "interest_rate": 0.1, "reference_payment_days": 30,
         "freight_eur_per_unit": {"DAP": 0.0, "EXW": 2.0}, "need_lead_time_days": 10, "current_unit_price": 30.0, "alternative": None}
    return {"buyer": b, "negotiable": ["unit_price", *options], "term_options": options, "round_limit": 10}


def _sup(price, i, body="", **terms):
    return {"from": "supplier", "status": "open", "body": body, "term_sheets": [{"term_sheet_id": f"s{i}", "terms": {"unit_price": price, "payment_days": 30, **terms}}]}


def _mine(price):
    return {"from": "buyer", "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": price, "payment_days": 30}}]}


def test_p02_never_accepts_or_offers_above_c_open():
    case = json.loads((CASES / "real" / "P02.json").read_text())
    msgs = json.loads((CASES / "real_runs_v17" / "simplify_P02.json").read_text())["threads"]["sup:70510"]["messages"]
    ends = [i for i, m in enumerate(msgs) if m["from"] != "buyer" and m.get("term_sheets")]
    agent = BetterAgent()
    for i in ends[1:]:  # every supplier reply the real run saw, the final_offer at 345.51 last
        ev = msgs[: i + 1]
        d = agent.decide(case, {"sup:70510": ev})
        c_open, std = BetterAgent()._open_c(case, {"sup:70510": ev}), standard_terms(ev)
        m = d["message"]
        if m.get("action", {}).get("type") == "accept":
            assert BetterAgent._est_c(case, ev, find_sheet(ev, m["action"]["term_sheet_id"]), std) <= c_open
        for s in m.get("term_sheets", []):
            assert BetterAgent._est_c(case, ev, s["terms"], std) <= c_open


def test_third_sheet_is_equal_cost_with_shorter_payment_and_lower_price():
    case = _case(payment_days=[14, 30, 60])
    std = {"unit_price": 30.0, "payment_days": 30}
    ev = [_sup(30.0, 0)]
    out = BetterAgent()._sheets(case, ev, std, std)
    main, third = out[0], out[-1]
    assert len(out) == 3 or len(out) == 2 and "index_clause" not in main  # main, (variant,) third
    assert third["payment_days"] < main["payment_days"] and third["unit_price"] < main["unit_price"]
    assert abs(total_cost(case, third, std) - total_cost(case, main, std)) < 100  # equal C up to a cent of price
    BetterAgent.THIRD_SHEET = False
    try:
        assert len(BetterAgent()._sheets(case, ev, std, std)) == len(out) - 1
    finally:
        BetterAgent.THIRD_SHEET = True


def test_cost_share_anchor_uses_the_index_drop_and_is_skipped_without_data():
    clause = {"series": "steel", "material_share": 0.5, "deadband_pct": 2.0}
    case = _case(index_clause=[None, clause])
    ev = [_sup(30.0, 0)]
    assert BetterAgent()._price(case, ev, 30.0) == 24.0  # no index path: the 0.80 rule
    case["buyer"]["index_paths"] = {"steel": -0.40}
    assert BetterAgent()._price(case, ev, 30.0) == 24.0  # max(0.75, 1 - 0.5 x 0.40) = 0.80 x 30
    case["buyer"]["index_paths"] = {"steel": -0.30}
    assert abs(BetterAgent()._price(case, ev, 30.0) - 0.85 * 30) < 1e-9


def test_cash_short_supplier_gets_a_shorter_payment_sheet():
    case = _case(payment_days=[14, 30, 60])
    std = {"unit_price": 30.0, "payment_days": 30}
    ev = [_sup(30.0, 0, body="We are short of cash this quarter.")]
    assert BetterAgent._cash_short(case, ev) and not BetterAgent._cash_short(case, [_sup(30.0, 0)])
    BetterAgent.THIRD_SHEET = False
    try:
        out = BetterAgent()._sheets(case, ev, std, std)
        assert len(out) == 2 and out[1]["payment_days"] < out[0]["payment_days"]
        assert len(BetterAgent()._sheets(case, [_sup(30.0, 0)], std, std)) == 1
    finally:
        BetterAgent.THIRD_SHEET = True


def test_late_accept_within_one_percent():
    case = _case()
    case["round_limit"] = 4
    ev = [_sup(30.0, 0), _mine(24.0), _sup(29.0, 1), _mine(26.0), _sup(28.9, 2)]  # 2 messages left; 28.9 is the best C
    d = BetterAgent().decide(case, {"t": ev})
    assert d["message"]["action"] == {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": "s2"}
    BetterAgent.LATE_ACCEPT = False
    try:
        assert BetterAgent().decide(case, {"t": ev})["message"].get("action") is None
    finally:
        BetterAgent.LATE_ACCEPT = True


def _hold_case():
    case = _case()
    case["round_limit"] = 8
    return case


def _status(ev, status):
    return [*ev[:-1], {**ev[-1], "status": status}]


def test_hold_for_final_counters_an_open_offer_but_closes_on_final_repeat_or_late():
    case = _hold_case()
    ev = [_sup(30.0, 0), _mine(24.0), _sup(24.0, 1)]  # open and met our price, 7 messages left
    assert BetterAgent().decide(case, {"t": ev})["message"].get("term_sheets")  # counter
    assert BetterAgent().decide(case, {"t": _status(ev, "final_offer")})["message"]["action"]["type"] == "accept"
    rep = [_sup(30.0, 0), _mine(24.0), _sup(28.0, 1), _mine(25.0), _sup(27.0, 2), _mine(26.0), _sup(27.0, 3)]  # same price twice: its floor
    assert BetterAgent().decide(case, {"t": rep})["message"]["action"]["type"] == "accept"
    late = [_sup(30.0, 0), _mine(24.0), _sup(27.0, 1), _mine(25.0), _sup(26.5, 2), _mine(25.5), _sup(26.0, 3), _mine(25.8), _sup(25.9, 4)]  # 4 sent
    case["round_limit"] = 6  # 2 left
    assert BetterAgent().decide(case, {"t": late})["message"]["action"]["type"] == "accept"  # <= 2 left
    BetterAgent.HOLD_FOR_FINAL = False
    try:
        assert BetterAgent().decide(_hold_case(), {"t": ev})["message"]["action"]["type"] == "accept"
    finally:
        BetterAgent.HOLD_FOR_FINAL = True


@needs_data
@pytest.mark.parametrize("pid", ["P01", "P02", "P03"])
def test_health_estimate_fits_the_arena_c_deal(pid):
    case = json.loads((CASES / "real" / f"{pid}.json").read_text())
    assert _health(case)["full_cost"] > 0
    dumps = [json.loads(Path(f).read_text()) for f in glob.glob(str(CASES / "real_runs*" / f"*_{pid}.json"))]
